status_of_prototype_results: superseded feasibility benchmark; it jointly optimized candidates and orientation and is not the staged user method
primary_method: unconstrained normal Doppler winner assignments, then one common orientation fitted to those frozen IDs across all 12 TRAIN scans, then one candidate refit among normal-visible RF-improving candidates compatible at every training sample
grid: tilt 1 degree; tilt azimuth and yaw 5 degrees; deterministic first-grid ties
objective: occupied-second weighted capped squared RMS/800Hz cost with every eligible >=3-second-span track retained in denominator
held_isolation: CFO, baseline assignments, orientation, and refit assignments use randomized training mask only; held residuals evaluated after freeze
scope: five prespecified unique cells, first six scans from each of two TRAIN groups; no geographic optimization, truth, VAL/TEST, new RF, or production change
